name: Stockpile
summary: Economic game of insider trading and market manipulation to amass the greatest net worth.
rules_text: Players start with $20k and one hidden stock. Game lasts a fixed number of rounds set by player count. Each round has six phases: Information: each player gets one secret Company card and one secret Forecast card indicating how that stock will move; one pair is public and remainder are hidden but will all move. Supply: a market card starts each Stockpile, then in turn order each player adds two cards from the deck to any Stockpiles, one face-up and one face-down (stocks, fees, or actions). Demand: players sequentially bid for Stockpiles using a meeple on a 0-25k bidding track, outbidding forces re-bids, until each pile has one winner who pays the bank and takes the pile secretly, paying any fee cards. Action: play any Boom (+2) or Bust (-2) action cards to move tickers immediately. Selling: in order players may sell any owned stocks at current ticker prices, split stocks pay double. Movement: reveal Company+Forecast pairs in order to move tickers, pay $2k per share on $$ dividend, handle splits and bankruptcy. Most cash plus stock value wins.
rating_reason: Economic investment and insider trading with hidden information
